title.narrative: Educational Physical Infrastructure Program (PIFE)
Proyecto de la Infraestructura Fsica Educativa (PIFE)

description.narrative: The general objective of the Educational Physical Infrastructure Project (PIFE) is to help improve physical conditions in the targeted schools where public basic education is offered, and build technical capacity to operate educational physical infrastructure in Mexico as part of the process to improve the quality of education offered in the country. The specific objectives are: (i) to improve infrastructure and equipment conditions in the targeted schools; (ii) to promote the upkeep of physical infrastructure, furniture, and equipment in the schools through knowledge transfer and guidance to the educational community; and (iii) to strengthen the information management system on educational physical infrastructure in the country so that it can function as an effective planning and decision-making tool.

Los objetivos especficos son: (i) mejorar las condiciones de infraestructura yequipamiento de los planteles educativos atendidos; (ii) fomentar la conservacin de la infraestructura fsica,mobiliario y equipo de las escuelas mediante la transferencia de conocimiento y orientacin a la comunidadeducativa; y (iii) fortalecer el sistema de gestin de la informacin de la infraestructura fsica educativa en el paspara que funcione como una herramienta efectiva de planificacin y toma de decisiones. Para lograr estosobjetivos, se han identificado los componentes y subcomponentes que se desarrollan a continuacin.
